featured_reviews.review_text: It has everything in Foods and of Good quality. A host of Diet snacks, very tasty though the packaging does not carry a nutritional chart. A little expensive but good stuff.

featured_reviews.name: bina bahl
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been going to appetite for many years , as much as it’s convenient it was always a chaotic store. Yesterday while waiting to pay my bill, I experienced the owner whose very comfortably sitting on the boss’s chair and a young staff member arguing and got it sick as they started abusing each other in Hindi. By this time I had paid and had to wait for my goods to be packed. At this point I turned around and asked him if he could carry this argument on after I leave, if they decide to swear at each other can they do it after the lady customers leave the shop. He sat there in his chair - cool , calmly swinging his chair from left to right and just nodded as if he had heard me talking to him in a whole different language.
Was appalled by the general etiquette of the boss. There are two brothers I know ... the one I saw yesterday had terrible attitude ..
sorry for this but just had to mention ...

featured_reviews.name: Yash Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text: December 2025: In store experience I had was me noticing that most of the products were having worn out packaging though the expiry dates were within valid time. After bringing a ladder with the help of the staff together we hunted for items that were actually fresh within the store. After careful selection I was yet a victim of purchasing items that were bad in quality. The chocolates section was having old wornout packaging and the inside product was exposed, though expiry dates were valid. Counter had maybe a few good fresh chocolates. The meat section purchase I made was to be good for 5 days as informed but after cooking the chicken the next day the stench of bad meat was noticed by my family. Though brands like conscious food is available here after taking the packet in the car I noticed that it was filled with ants as the package was exposed enough for them to enter within the store shelf. Products unorganised and dust gathering on them in the mid sections. The product from fridge section I got being dosa batter, had bad smell and taste though the expiry dates were valid, post cooking experience. Upon pointing out to staff a few products were bad I had later come to the understanding that most of the items were bad in store. Even after carefully hunting for items I failed to get good quality products on my spending. This was once my favourite store for a long time. Would not recommend to anyone today unfortunately.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"Hi Yash, 
Thank you for connecting with us & sorry for the inconvenience caused. Please DM us your invoice/contact details, as our team would like to connect with you to understand the details & investigate this further. Kindly feel free to reach out to us on cs@naturesbasket.co.in or call on 8880077745"

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Reliance Mart, Mumbai Central. The store was poorly maintained, the floors were dirty, and overall cleanliness was far below expected standards. Staff behavior was unprofessional and lacked basic courtesy. There was no proper coordination among employees, making the shopping experience frustrating.

The worst part was at the billing counter. After standing in line for nearly 15 minutes, I was informed that only cash payments were being accepted and that card payments were unavailable. Customers should be informed about such issues before they spend time shopping and waiting in long queues. This caused unnecessary inconvenience and wasted time.

Management seriously needs to improve cleanliness, staff behavior, communication, and payment facilities. Overall, a very poor shopping experience that did not meet basic customer service expectations.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Reshma Soni, Please accept our sincerest apologies that we didn't live up to your expectations on this occasion. We're thankful that you reached out to share your experience as your valuable feedback helps us to better serve our clients. Please reach out to us at customerservice@ril.com to discuss how we can make this right.

Thanks & Regards,
SMART Bazaar India

featured_reviews.name: Danish Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reliance Smart is a convenient one-stop supermarket for daily groceries and household essentials. You can find a wide variety of products like fruits, vegetables, packaged food, dairy items, and personal care products all in one place, which makes shopping easy and time-saving. 🛒  
India
The store is usually well-organized, and there are frequent discounts and offers, which help save money on regular purchases. 🏷️
However, during peak hours it can get quite crowded, and billing counters may take some time. Also, product availability can sometimes be inconsistent.
Overall, it’s a good place for regular shopping needs, especially if you are looking for affordable prices and variety. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Abhi Dabholkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Reliance Smart was completely unacceptable and highly unprofessional.
The store officially closes at 11:00 PM. We entered at around 10:10 PM, which is well within the permitted shopping time. Despite this, a staff member approached us at approximately 10:15 PM and aggressively insisted that we stop shopping and proceed to billing immediately.
To make matters worse, the staff deliberately switched off the lights in the section where we were selecting items—clearly an attempt to force us out. This kind of behavior is not only rude but also humiliating for customers.
This reflects extremely poor management, lack of basic customer service ethics, and zero respect for customers’ time. If the store intends to stop allowing customers before closing time, it should clearly communicate accurate timings instead of misleading people.
Such disgraceful conduct from staff at a reputed brand like Reliance is shocking. Immediate action, strict staff training, and accountability are required.
strongly discourage others from visiting this outlet if this is the level of service being provided. Completely unacceptable.
